text:
cora: heads-up: customer POC failing - Node and Python sampleapps returning different embedding dims after batch-helper rewrite. Node -> requested pad applied, Python silently strips trailing zeros.

ben: do you have a tiny repro?

cora: Node request:
```json
{"model":"embed-core-v1","inputs":[[0.01,0.02]],"pad_to":640}
```
Python request:
```json
{"model":"embed-core-v1","vectors":[[0.01,0.02]],"pad_len":640,"strip_trailing_zeros":true}
```
Node sees 640-d, Python client stores 512-d. Indexing and cosine ranks diverge.

ivy: also saw rerank `scores` coming back as strings from an old Python serializer causing comparator TypeError.

sdk-qa: likely fallout from helper refactor - option name drift (`pad_to` vs `pad_len`) + new boolean default. Also retryer mismatch: Node sends `Idempotency-Key`, Python retryer uses internal `Retry-Id` header and doesn't translate -> duplicate inserts on 409.

harry: plan: 1) change python helper to `pad_to` and set `strip_trailing_zeros=false` by default, 2) map retryer id -> `Idempotency-Key`, 3) add client-side batch sanity check (all embeddings same dim), 4) coerce/validate rerank `scores` as floats on parse.

ben: i'll open patches: sdk-python PR (draft) and server guard to return `meta.embedding_dim` and reject variable-length batches with 400.

sdk-qa: adding cross-language integ test that runs node+python sampleapps (docker-compose) with mixed lengths N=80, asserts dims equal and scores numeric, simulates 409 retries to validate idempotency header mapping.

ops-bot: deploy: staging hotfix branch `hotfix/sync-pad-headers` deployed (build 1145).

cora: thanks. if hotfix passes, recommend adding a pre-merge parity lint job to detect mismatched option names across SDK repos.

ben: agreed. PR links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/1840 (wip), https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/5102 (wip).

sdk-qa: staging run (2k requests) shows dims normalized after patch, rerank scores parsed as floats, no duplicates observed. Closing loop.
